name: css_animation_out
description: -azul-animation-out DRIVES THE ZOMBIE. #sidebar declares `-azul-animation-out: flyOutRight 1s` (builtin table; no @keyframes needed). Unmounting it retains the subtree as a zombie whose motion comes from the compiled track (translate right + width narrowing + clip to the frozen rect), NOT the default slide. The zombie must survive mid-flight ticks and reap exactly when the track completes - a zombie that outlives its animation is a leak, one that dies early truncates the exit. Companion pins: window::tests::builtin_fly_out_right_shifts_right_and_narrows_to_zero (track shape) and stylesheet_keyframes_shadow_the_builtin_table (author @keyframes take precedence over the builtin of the same name). DISCRIMINATOR (post no-defaults ruling): retention itself is the tell - a seeded track means zombies:1 for the whole 1s exit; a failed resolution means NO retention at all (zombies:0 instantly), which is exactly what the NC sabotage produces. (Names are @keyframes-declared: there are NO engine builtins - USER ruling - and no default slides; an undeclared unmount just disappears.)

css: html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
@keyframes flyOutLeft { from { transform: translateX(0px); } to { transform: translateX(-100%); } }
